Just a quick question...

Does the card you called a vote with count as a 1 vote?

Anneke calls a vote for Kindred Restrucure. She's worth 3 (justicar)
Anson is worth 2 (prince), and Andreas is worth 1 (primogen). Is the
vote total 6 (total of titled vamps) or 7 (titled vamps +1 for the
card itself, Kindred Restructure)

Thanks,

chris

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
rhodesc@medicine (Chris Rhodes) writes:

>Just a quick question...




A Political Action card played to call a vote DOES provide one vote, yes.
A card in play that allows a vote to be called (Rumors, Archon, etc.)
does NOT provide a vote, as it is not being played at the time the vote is
called.
